## Role

- [ ] Supervisor engineering PR
- [ ] Executor evidence-only PR

## Scope

Describe exactly what changed and why.

## Safety / protected invariants

- [ ] No energized open-PCB procedure introduced.
- [ ] No secrets/raw device identifiers committed.
- [ ] Relay/button/LED/pairing/OTA invariants considered where applicable.
- [ ] GPIO/calibration values are evidence-backed, not guessed.

## Validation

List exact commands/tests and results.

## Evidence

Link the controlling issue and relevant sanitized run paths.

## Rollback

Describe how to revert this change or evidence import.
